Booking form

Now

After

  • Steps: Car → Package (only services that have packages) → Book your schedule → Branch & where you heard about us → Summary, then a Thank-you screen.
  • Package step works like the Tint Finder result: your answers on top, “★ Our pick for you”, then one card per package with its warranty and the price for YOUR car size.

  • Car size is gone from the form. It comes from My cars. The price waits for the end.
  • Schedule uses a month calendar instead of the two-week strip. Today and tomorrow stay closed.
  • Branch moves into the form, with “Where did you hear about us?” just before the summary.
  • The summary is a table with the price as the last line. The submit goes to the Bookings board in the team portal, and the branch admin / team lead / super admins already get a push + inbox alert (“Booking received”).
  • Fonts: step titles, the price and “Thank you” leave the all-caps poster face for the normal bold face.
